annotations.title: Not man but God.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> He that despiseth the Churches or her lavvful Pastors precepts, offendeth no lesse then if he contemned Gods expresse commaundements. For they be of the holy Ghost, and are not to be counted among the commaundements of men onely.

annotations.title: Sleepe.
annotations.text: Some Heretikes peruersly inferred of this that the soules did sleepe til the day of iudgement: vvhere it is meant of the bodies onely.
